```{python}
#| label: datos-base
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

dirs = sorted(Path("../lake/serving/indicador_diario").glob("fecha=*/"))
frames = []
for d in dirs:
    try:
        part = pd.read_parquet(d)
        part["fecha"] = d.name.replace("fecha=", "")
        frames.append(part)
    except Exception:
        pass
df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) if frames else pd.DataFrame()
ult = df["fecha"].max() if not df.empty else "s/d"
base = df[df["fecha"] == ult].copy() if not df.empty else df
latam = base[base["region"] == "LatAm"].copy() if not base.empty else base

def f1(x, dec=1):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:.{dec}f}"

def entero(x):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:,.0f}"
```

```{python}
#| label: visor-maestro
#| fig-cap: "Visor maestro multicapa a pantalla completa: PM2.5, temperatura, caudal, IDW y poligonos geoespaciales"
import math
import folium
from folium.plugins import MarkerCluster, Fullscreen, HeatMap, MiniMap
from branca.element import MacroElement
from folium.template import Template
import branca.colormap as cm

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(".").resolve()))
from src.geo.map_components import capas_poligonos, html_leyenda_poligonos

ESRI_CALLES = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
ESRI_SAT = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
OMS = {"Buena": "#2d6a4f", "Moderada": "#ee9b00", "Dañina (sensible)": "#ca6702",
       "Dañina": "#bb3e03", "Muy dañina": "#9d0208", "Peligrosa": "#6a040f"}


class EcoLegend(MacroElement):
    """Leyenda como control Leaflet (bottomleft): viaja con el mapa en
    fullscreen y no intercepta el botón."""
    _template = Template("""
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
        .eco-legend{background:#fff;padding:0;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;
          line-height:1.45;color:#212529;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15);max-width:250px}
        .eco-legend details{margin:0}
        .eco-legend summary{cursor:pointer;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:700;list-style:none;
          border-bottom:1px solid #f1f3f5;font-size:0.9rem}
        .eco-legend summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
        .eco-legend summary::after{content:" ▾";color:#52796f}
        .eco-legend details:not([open]) summary::after{content:" ▸"}
        .eco-legend .eco-body{padding:0 16px 14px}
        .eco-legend .eco-hint{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #e6e8e6;
          font-size:11px;color:#6c757d}
        .eco-legend .dot{font-size:13px;margin-right:8px}
        .eco-legend .legend-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 0;
          font-size:0.88rem}
        .eco-legend .legend-group-title{font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
          letter-spacing:0.08em;color:#6b7280;margin:10px 0 6px;padding:0 4px;}
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          var leg = L.control({position: 'bottomleft'});
          leg.onAdd = function(map){
            var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'eco-legend leaflet-control');
            div.innerHTML = {{this.html_legend|tojson}};
            L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
            L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
            return div;
          };
          leg.addTo(mapObj);
          mapObj.scrollWheelZoom.disable();
          if (window.innerWidth < 640 && mapObj.dragging) {
            mapObj.dragging.disable();
            mapObj.once('click', function(){ mapObj.dragging.enable(); });
          }
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
    """)

    def __init__(self, html_legend):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "EcoLegend"
        self.html_legend = html_legend


def popup(dominio, p, filas):
    """Popup con borde de color por dominio y tipografía Inter."""
    color = {"aire": "#ee9b00", "clima": "#219ebc", "agua": "#01497c"}.get(dominio, "#6c757d")
    rows = "".join(f"<tr><td>{k}</td><td><b>{v}</b></td></tr>" for k, v in filas)
    html = (
        f"<div class='eco-popup' style='border-left:4px solid {color}; "
        f"font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:13px;'>"
        f"<div style='font-weight:700; color:{color}; margin-bottom:6px; border-bottom:1px solid #e6e8e6; padding-bottom:4px;'>"
        f"<b>{p['ciudad']}</b> <span style='font-weight:400; font-size:0.85rem; opacity:0.8;'>({p['pais']})</span></div>"
        f"<table style='width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;'>{rows}</table></div>"
    )
    return folium.Popup(html, max_width=320)


m = folium.Map(location=[-12, -62], zoom_start=3, tiles=None, control_scale=True,
               preferCanvas=True, scrollWheelZoom=False)
folium.TileLayer("OpenStreetMap", name="Calles OSM", show=False).add_to(m)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_CALLES, attr="Esri", name="Esri calles", show=False).add_to(m)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_SAT, attr="Esri", name="Satélite").add_to(m)

# ---- Capas de polígonos (FONDO - se dibujan primero, debajo de todo) ----
g_paises, g_urbanas, g_cuencas = capas_poligonos()
if g_paises: g_paises.add_to(m)
if g_cuencas: g_cuencas.add_to(m)
if g_urbanas: g_urbanas.add_to(m)

overlay_path = Path(f"../lake/serving/superficies/fecha={ult}/pm25.png")
if overlay_path.exists():
    g_idw = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Superficie IDW · PM2.5", show=False)
    folium.raster_layers.ImageOverlay(
        str(overlay_path), bounds=[[-56, -120], [33, -30]],
        opacity=0.65, name="IDW PM2.5",
    ).add_to(g_idw)
    g_idw.add_to(m)

g_aire = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Aire · PM2.5", show=False)
mc_a = MarkerCluster().add_to(g_aire)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).iterrows():
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=4 + min(float(p["pm25_media"]), 150) / 18,
        color=OMS.get(p["categoria_pm25_aqi"], "#6c757d"), fill=True, fill_opacity=0.8,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: PM2.5 {p['pm25_media']:.1f} ug/m3 ({p['categoria_pm25_aqi']})",
        popup=popup("aire", p, [("PM2.5", f"{p['pm25_media']:.1f} µg/m³"),
                        ("Categoria", p["categoria_pm25_aqi"]), ("AQI US max", f1(p["us_aqi_max"], 0))]),
    ).add_to(mc_a)
g_aire.add_to(m)

col_temp = cm.LinearColormap(["#2166ac", "#fee08b", "#b2182b"], vmin=0, vmax=35)
g_clima = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Clima - Temp/lluvia", show=False)
mc_c = MarkerCluster().add_to(g_clima)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c"]).iterrows():
    ll = 0 if pd.isna(p["precipitacion_mm"]) else float(p["precipitacion_mm"])
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=4 + min(ll, 60) / 8,
        color=col_temp(float(p["temp_media_c"])), fill=True, fill_opacity=0.8,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: {p['temp_media_c']:.1f} C · {ll:.1f} mm",
        popup=popup("clima", p, [("Temp. media", f"{p['temp_media_c']:.1f} C"),
                        ("Precipitacion", f"{ll:.1f} mm"), ("Viento max", f"{f1(p['viento_max_kmh'])} km/h")]),
    ).add_to(mc_c)
g_clima.add_to(m)

g_agua = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Agua - Caudal (log)", show=False)
mc_h = MarkerCluster().add_to(g_agua)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["caudal_m3s"]).iterrows():
    qq = float(p["caudal_m3s"])
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=3 + 4 * math.log10(1 + qq),
        color="#01497c", fill=True, fill_opacity=0.75,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: {qq:,.0f} m3/s",
        popup=popup("agua", p, [("Caudal", f"{qq:,.0f} m³/s"), ("Tipo", "Cuenca" if p.get("es_cuenca") else "Ciudad")]),
    ).add_to(mc_h)
g_agua.add_to(m)

hg = folium.FeatureGroup(name="Calor · PM2.5 (heatmap)", show=False)
HeatMap(
    [[p["lat"], p["lon"], float(p["pm25_media"])] for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).iterrows()],
    radius=18, blur=12, max_zoom=6, min_opacity=0.35,
).add_to(hg)
hg.add_to(m)

items_oms = "".join(f"<div><span class='dot' style='color:{c}'>●</span> {k}</div>" for k, c in OMS.items())
items_poly = html_leyenda_poligonos()
EcoLegend(f"<details open><summary>Leyenda del mapa</summary><div class='eco-body'>"
          f"<div class='legend-group-title'>PM2.5 (AQI EE. UU.)</div>{items_oms}"
          f"<hr style='border:none;border-top:1px solid #e6e8e6;margin:8px 0;'>"
          f"<div class='legend-group-title'>Capas geoespaciales</div>{items_poly}"
          f"<div class='eco-hint'>Polígonos activos por defecto · usa el LayerControl arriba a la derecha para alternar</div>"
          f"</div></details>").add_to(m)
MiniMap(toggle_display=True, position="bottomright", width=110, height=110).add_to(m)
Fullscreen(position="topright", title="Pantalla completa",
           title_cancel="Salir de pantalla completa", force_separate_button=True).add_to(m)

# ---- Control de opacidad por capa ----
class OpacityControl(MacroElement):
    _template = Template("""
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
        .eco-opacity{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;
          box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.15);max-width:240px;font-size:12px;
          font-family:Inter,sans-serif;border:1px solid #e6e8e6;}
        .eco-opacity .eco-title{font-weight:700;color:#0b3d2e;margin-bottom:10px;
          font-size:0.85rem;display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;}
        .eco-opacity .eco-item{margin-bottom:12px;}
        .eco-opacity .eco-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
        .eco-opacity label{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;
          color:#374151;font-size:0.78rem;}
        .eco-opacity input[type=range]{width:100%;cursor:pointer;accent-color:#0b3d2e;}
        .eco-opacity .eco-val{float:right;font-size:0.75rem;color:#6b7280;}
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'eco-opacity leaflet-control');
          div.innerHTML = {{this.html|tojson}};
          L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
          L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);

          var layers = {};
          mapObj.eachLayer(function(layer){
            if (layer.options && layer.options.name) {
              layers[layer.options.name] = layer;
            }
          });

          function setOpacity(name, val){
            var layer = layers[name];
            if (!layer) return;
            if (layer.setOpacity) layer.setOpacity(val);
            else if (layer.getLayers) {
              layer.getLayers().forEach(function(l){ if(l.setOpacity) l.setOpacity(val); });
            }
          }

          div.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]').forEach(function(input){
            input.addEventListener('input', function(e){
              setOpacity(input.dataset.layer, e.target.value);
              input.nextElementSibling.textContent = e.target.value;
            });
          });

          return div;
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
    """)

    def __init__(self, html):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "OpacityControl"
        self.html = html

opacity_html = """<div class='eco-opacity'>
<span class='eco-title'>Opacidad de capas</span>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Aire · PM2.5</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Aire · PM2.5'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Clima · Temp/lluvia</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Clima · Temp/lluvia'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Agua · Caudal</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Agua · Caudal (log)'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Superficie IDW · PM2.5</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='0.65' data-layer='IDW PM2.5'>
<span class='eco-val'>0.65</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Países (contexto)</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Países'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Áreas urbanas</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Área urbana'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
<div class='eco-item'><label>Cuencas hidrográficas</label>
<input type='range' min='0' max='1' step='0.1' value='1' data-layer='Cuenca'>
<span class='eco-val'>1</span></div>
</div>"""
OpacityControl(opacity_html).add_to(m)

folium.LayerControl(collapsed=True).add_to(m)
m
```

## 02 · Analisis cruzado — Hallazgos de los datos

<section class="analisis-dedicado">

¿El calor y la lluvia mueven la contaminación? Dos cruces rápidos, con la guía OMS como referencia.

```{python}
#| label: cruzados-maestro
import plotly.express as px

cru = base.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c", "pm25_media"])
fig1 = px.scatter(cru, x="temp_media_c", y="pm25_media", color="region", hover_name="ciudad",
                  title="Temp. media vs PM2.5",
                  labels={"temp_media_c": "Temp. media C", "pm25_media": "PM2.5 ug/m3"})
fig1.add_hline(y=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 ug/m3")
fig1.update_layout(height=420, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig1.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

cru2 = base.dropna(subset=["precipitacion_mm", "us_aqi_max"])
fig2 = px.scatter(cru2, x="precipitacion_mm", y="us_aqi_max", color="region", hover_name="ciudad",
                  title="Precipitación vs AQI máximo",
                  labels={"precipitacion_mm": "Precipitacion mm", "us_aqi_max": "AQI US max"})
fig2.update_layout(height=420, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig2.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})
```

```{python}
#| label: slider-temporal-maestro
#| fig-cap: "PM2.5 animado día a día (últimos 14 días)"
from folium.plugins import TimestampedGeoJson, MiniMap, Fullscreen
from branca.element import MacroElement
from folium.template import Template


class EcoMobile(MacroElement):
    """Comportamiento móvil: no atrapa el scroll de página."""
    _template = Template("""
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          mapObj.scrollWheelZoom.disable();
          if (window.innerWidth < 640 && mapObj.dragging) {
            mapObj.dragging.disable();
            mapObj.once('click', function(){ mapObj.dragging.enable(); });
          }
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
    """)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "EcoMobile"


hist = df.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).copy()
fechas14 = sorted(hist["fecha"].unique())[-14:]
hh = hist[hist["fecha"].isin(fechas14)]

feats = []
for _, p in hh.sort_values("fecha").iterrows():
    c = OMS.get(p["categoria_pm25_aqi"], "#6c757d")
    feats.append({
        "type": "Feature",
        "geometry": {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [float(p["lon"]), float(p["lat"])]},
        "properties": {
            "time": f"{p['fecha']}T00:00:00",
            "popup": f"<b>{p['ciudad']}</b> ({p['fecha']}): {p['pm25_media']:.1f} ug/m3",
            "icon": "circle",
            "iconstyle": {"fillColor": c, "fillOpacity": 0.85, "color": c,
                          "radius": 5 + min(float(p["pm25_media"]), 150) / 15},
        },
    })

mt = folium.Map(location=[-12, -62], zoom_start=3, tiles=None, control_scale=True,
                preferCanvas=True, scrollWheelZoom=False)
folium.TileLayer("OpenStreetMap", name="Calles OSM").add_to(mt)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_SAT, attr="Esri", name="Satélite").add_to(mt)
TimestampedGeoJson(
    {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": feats},
    period="P1D", transition_time=600, loop=False, auto_play=False,
    add_last_point=False, date_options="YYYY-MM-DD",
).add_to(mt)
EcoMobile().add_to(mt)
MiniMap(toggle_display=True, position="bottomright", width=100, height=100).add_to(mt)
Fullscreen(position="topright", title="Pantalla completa",
           title_cancel="Salir de pantalla completa", force_separate_button=True).add_to(mt)
folium.LayerControl(collapsed=True).add_to(mt)
mt
```
